claims.label: Blake Neff Reported Discussing Candace Owens's Anticipated Reaction in Hospital Waiting Room on September 10
claims.claim: According to a Deseret News profile piece, Blake Neff stated he was with members sitting in the waiting room at the Orem, Utah hospital where Kirk was taken on September 10 and was discussing how podcaster Candace Owens would react to Charlie's death.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original Deseret News article text directly and confirm the quoted material matches the host's reading; verify whether Neff names the other "members" present.

claims.label: Blake Neff Stated Charlie Kirk Was Aware of Owens's Theories About France's First Lady Being Transgender
claims.claim: According to the Deseret News profile, Blake Neff stated Charlie Kirk was aware of Candace Owens's theories about France's first lady being transgender.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the exact Neff wording in the original Deseret News article; identify the source Neff cites for this characterization.

claims.label: Blake Neff Described Some of Candace Owens's Views as "Weird Stuff About Jewish Cults"
claims.claim: According to the Deseret News profile, Blake Neff described some of Candace Owens's views as "weird stuff about Jewish cults."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the exact phrasing in the original Deseret News article; identify which specific views Neff was referencing.

claims.label: Blake Neff Stated TPUSA Reduced Involvement With Owens Around 2024 Due to Her Views
claims.claim: According to the Deseret News profile, Blake Neff stated that some of Candace Owens's views were part of the reason Turning Point USA had become less involved with Owens around 2024.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the exact Neff statement in the Deseret News article; corroborate against TPUSA's public posture and timeline around 2024.

claims.label: Blake Neff Characterized Candace Owens as "Seven Vacations a Year Owens"
claims.claim: Blake Neff, in an X post read aloud on the episode, called Candace Owens "seven vacations a year Owens" and stated she cannot imagine someone liking work.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original X post URL and confirm text; cross-check the host's counter-travel record against verifiable travel logs.

claims.label: Erika Kirk Published a One-Year Grief Op-Ed in The New York Times
claims.claim: Erika Kirk published a one-year look back on her grief in an op-ed for The New York Times, with portions read aloud by the host.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the op-ed in NYT archives; verify publication date, paywall status, and full text directly.

claims.label: Erika Kirk's Op-Ed Recounts Telling Second Lady Usha Vance "I Don't Know How I'm Going to Do This"
claims.claim: In her NYT op-ed, Erika Kirk recounts telling Second Lady Usha Vance "I don't know how I'm going to do this" on the day after Charlie Kirk was shot.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm the quoted sentence in the op-ed directly; cross-check against Vance-family public statements.

claims.label: Erika Kirk's Op-Ed Cites Usha Vance's "15 Minutes" Airplane Analogy About Grief
claims.claim: In her NYT op-ed, Erika Kirk cites Usha Vance's "15 minutes" airplane analogy about grief – that the worst stretch is like a plane descending with screaming children before landing.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm the quoted analogy in the op-ed directly.

claims.label: Erika Kirk's Op-Ed States She Is Not Angry at God and Characterizes Her Husband as "One of One"
claims.claim: In her NYT op-ed, Erika Kirk writes that she is not angry at God, that her husband was "one of one," that she was "blessed to be his wife," and that she "understood his assignment here on Earth."
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm the quoted language in the op-ed directly.

claims.label: Erika Kirk's Op-Ed Closes With Reference to "A Dear Friend" Telling Her to "Just Get Through the Next 15 Minutes"
claims.claim: In her NYT op-ed, the closing lines reference "a dear friend" telling the author to "just get through the next 15 minutes," with the "15 minutes" phrase repeated as a refrain.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm the closing lines directly in the op-ed; identify whether the op-ed identifies the "dear friend" by name.

claims.label: Candace Owens Encountered Kim Kardashian in Hotel Lobby at Ye's Chicago Concert
claims.claim: The host describes, with video footage, encountering Kim Kardashian in the hotel lobby at Ye's Chicago homecoming concert and exchanging a half-smile across the lobby.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the footage timestamp and attendees independently; confirm the date and venue.

claims.label: Charlie Kirk Publicly Stated He Reads The New York Times "So You Don't Have To"
claims.claim: In a clip played on the episode, Charlie Kirk publicly states he reads The New York Times "so you don't have to."
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the original episode and date of the clip; verify the exact wording.

claims.label: Salem Media and "Waterstone" Are Releasing a Charlie Kirk Documentary Titled "Can You Hear Me Now?"
claims.claim: According to a viewer comment read aloud on the episode, Salem Media and "Waterstone" are releasing a Charlie Kirk documentary with an alleged unreleased interview filmed shortly before September 10, titled "Can You Hear Me Now?"
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the documentary's existence via official Salem Media and "Waterstone" press releases; confirm the title, release date, and the existence of any unreleased interview footage.

claims.label: Host Says Ye Is Selling Out 70,000 to 100,000 Seat Stadiums Worldwide
claims.claim: The host says Ye has been touring and selling out stadiums of 70,000 to 100,000 seats around the world, a tour she compares to Taylor Swift's Eras Tour, amid what she calls a media blackout.
claims.investigative_direction: Check announced attendance and ticketing figures for Ye's 2026 stadium dates against the host's range.
claims.transcript_snippet: he has been touring and he has been selling out stadiums that are between 70,000-100,000 seats all over the world

claims.label: Host Says Critics Posted Grok Answer on Concert Safety at 8 Months Pregnant
claims.claim: The host says one critic posted a conversation with Grok about whether it was safe for her to attend a concert at 8 months pregnant, and that Grok answered that the baby could be startled by the music.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the posted Grok exchange to confirm the wording and that it was generated as described.
claims.transcript_snippet: I saw one person posted their conversation with Grok about whether it's safe for me to go to a concert at 8 months pregnant.

claims.label: Host Says Critics Who Excused Funeral Fireworks Condemned Ye Concert Happiness
claims.claim: The host says the same people who told the audience that overwhelming happiness and fireworks at Charlie Kirk's funeral were normal then argued that happiness and fireworks at a Ye concert a year later were unacceptable.
claims.investigative_direction: Collect the posts defending funeral fireworks and the posts criticizing the Ye concert to see whether the same accounts made both arguments.
claims.transcript_snippet: And then I saw the same people who told us that overwhelming happiness and fireworks displayed at a funeral was perfectly normal stuff, right?

claims.label: Host Says Defenders Excused Funeral Fireworks by Saying Charlie Loved Pyrotechnics
claims.claim: The host says the excuse offered for the fireworks at Charlie Kirk's funeral was that Charlie loved pyrotechnics, and she calls that a bizarre way to argue that people were wrong to feel uneasy about the celebratory tone.
claims.investigative_direction: Find the TPUSA statements explaining the memorial fireworks and who authorized the pyrotechnic display.
claims.transcript_snippet: They were like, "Charlie loved pyrotechnics." Yeah, I'm sure he did when he was celebrating.

claims.label: Host Says Charlie Was From Chicago, Loved Kanye and the Song Homecoming
claims.claim: The host says Charlie Kirk was from Chicago and proud of it, that he loved Kanye thanks to her, and that he especially loved the song Homecoming, Kanye's ode to Chicago.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm from Kirk's own posts or interviews that he named Homecoming as a favorite song.
claims.transcript_snippet: you guys know Charlie was from Chicago. He's very proud of that. He loved Kanye.

claims.label: Host Says Ye's Team Refused Payment and Hosted Her at the Chicago Show
claims.claim: The host says she began planning months ago to attend Ye's Chicago show, offered to pay, and was told by Ye's team "Absolutely not" as they went above and beyond for her party.
claims.investigative_direction: Not independently checkable beyond the host's account; note as hospitality disclosure relevant to her coverage of Ye.
claims.transcript_snippet: We were willing, of course, to pay ourselves to go, but Ye's team was like, "Absolutely not."

claims.label: Host Says Kim Kardashian Was in Chicago for North West's Show the Next Night
claims.claim: The host says Kim Kardashian, whom she saw in the hotel lobby, turned out to be in town for a show that North West had the following night.
claims.investigative_direction: Check coverage of North West's Chicago show date to confirm it fell the night after the Ye concert.
claims.transcript_snippet: Turns out she was actually in town for a show that Northwest had the following night.

claims.label: Host Says She Went Down to Crowd Surf at 8 Months Pregnant
claims.claim: The host says she went down to the floor of the arena and crowd surfed at 8 months pregnant.
claims.investigative_direction: None beyond the host's own account; recorded for the pregnancy timeline (maternity leave announced at 00:55:33).
claims.transcript_snippet: I was down to crowd surf at 8 months pregnant. It's just who I am.

claims.label: Host Says She Introduced Charlie to Ye's Music on a Denver Rental-Car Drive
claims.claim: The host says that on a three-hour drive in a rental car picked up at Denver Airport she found Charlie did not know Kanye West's music, took him through it, and turned him into a big Ye fan who ran 10 miles a day to the music.
claims.investigative_direction: Look for texts between the host and Kirk about Ye's music and for the date of the Denver trip.
claims.transcript_snippet: turned Charlie into a big Ye fan. He would then run 10 miles a day to his music and we would text about it all the time

claims.label: Kanye in 2013 BBC Clip Says His Fans Are Fans of Themselves
claims.claim: In a 2013 BBC interview clip played by the host, Kanye West says his music is the codes of self-esteem and that a Kanye West fan is not a fan of him but a fan of themselves.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the original 2013 BBC interview and confirm the quoted passage.
claims.transcript_snippet: If you're a Kanye West fan, you're not a fan of me, you're a fan of yourself.

claims.label: Host Says Her College Debt Cost About $150,000 in Student Loans
claims.claim: The host says that signing up for college out of peer pressure and insecurity cost her about $150,000 in student loans.
claims.investigative_direction: Personal biographical statement; no external record needed.
claims.transcript_snippet: That's peer pressure and insecurity which cost me about $150,000 in student loans

claims.label: Host Says the Media Could Create and Delete People With a Department of Defense Level Budget
claims.claim: The host says that for a long time the media had the power to create and delete people with what seemed like a Department of Defense level budget, and that the media operated as digital assassins until Ye.
claims.investigative_direction: Opinion about media power; no specific budget or program is identified on air.
claims.transcript_snippet: the media had the power to create and to delete people with what seemed like a Department of Defense level budget.

claims.label: Host Says Ye's Adidas and Gap Deals Were Worth Billions and Required Silence on Politics
claims.claim: The host says Ye's Adidas and Gap deals were worth billions and that all he had to do to keep them was stay quiet about politics, and later that he lost them and his billionaire status when they were pulled.
claims.investigative_direction: Check Adidas and Gap termination announcements and reported deal values.
claims.transcript_snippet: And then came even bigger offers, the Adidas and the Gap deals, and they were worth billions. And all Ye had to do to maintain that was to shut up about politics.

claims.label: Host Says She Was Pressed at the Daily Wire to Condemn Kanye's Defcon 3 Tweet
claims.claim: The host says that after Kanye tweeted he would go Defcon 3 on some Jewish people, everyone with a platform was pressed to condemn him, and her Daily Wire colleagues needed her in particular to make a statement because they knew she was his friend.
claims.investigative_direction: Seek corroboration of the conference-room meeting and the proposed statement text from Daily Wire staff or contemporaneous messages.
claims.transcript_snippet: they needed me to make that statement because they knew I was friends with him.

claims.label: Host Says the Daily Wire Co-CEO Banged His Fists Demanding a Statement for Ben
claims.claim: The host says a Daily Wire co-CEO banged his fists in a heated conference and asked why she would not make a statement, asking whether she realized how hard it was for Ben that she would not.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify attendees of the meeting and whether any record or recollection confirms the exchange.
claims.transcript_snippet: literally the co-CEO banged his fists. He was like, "Why won't you do this for us? Don't you realize how hard this is for Ben that you won't make a statement?"

claims.label: Host Says Daily Wire Changed Her Contract and She Lost Millions Over Kanye
claims.claim: The host says she held the line on not condemning Kanye, lost millions because of it, and that the Daily Wire edited her contract with a different clause because of what Kanye said.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the pre- and post-incident contract language and the amendment date.
claims.transcript_snippet: I lost millions because of it. Yeah, they changed my contract because of it.

claims.label: Host Says the Ask of Her Is to Stay Silent or Pretend the Lone-Gunman Evidence Is Overwhelming
claims.claim: The host says that at her level the ask is to say nothing about Charlie Kirk's assassination, or to say something and pretend to be overwhelmed by the evidence that one person did it alone, in exchange for money, and adds "I think people are doing it for a lot less."
claims.investigative_direction: The host names no payer or recipient; ask her to identify any offer made to her or others and any documentation of it.
claims.transcript_snippet: the ask is simply um say nothing about Charlie Kirk's assassination or say something and pretend to be overwhelmed by the evidence that this one person did it and act alone.

claims.label: Host Says Kolvet Told Her Bibi Offered to Take Turning Point to the Next Level
claims.claim: The host says that she knows what Andrew told her, namely that Bibi Netanyahu offered to take Turning Point to the next level.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm with Kolvet or the other sources the host has cited in earlier episodes what exactly was offered and when.
claims.transcript_snippet: I know what Andrew told me. BB offered to take Turning Point to the next level.

claims.label: Host Says Charlie Faced Offers at a Table in His Final Weeks and Said No
claims.claim: The host says Charlie Kirk was at a table in his final weeks where offers were made to him and that she thinks everyone knows he said no, as Ye did.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the table, attendees and date of the meeting where offers were allegedly made (the host elsewhere points to the Hamptons retreat).
claims.transcript_snippet: when he was at a table and offers were made to him and I think we all know that he said no.

claims.label: Host Says Ye Told Her He Was Finally Free Within Hours of Adidas Ending the Deal
claims.claim: The host says she spoke to Ye by phone within hours of Adidas's public announcement and that, rather than being upset, he said he was finally free.
claims.investigative_direction: Date the Adidas announcement and match it to the host's recollection of the call.
claims.transcript_snippet: I will never forget what he said. He said I'm finally free.

claims.label: Host Says She Tweeted the Rumors Are True I Am Finally Free on Leaving the Daily Wire
claims.claim: The host says that about a year and a half later, when her departure from the Daily Wire (which she calls being fired) was announced, she tweeted "The rumors are true. I am finally free."
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve the original tweet and its date to confirm the wording and timing relative to the Adidas call.
claims.transcript_snippet: I tweeted, "The rumors are true. I am finally free."

claims.label: Host Says a Zionist Lobby Got Her Banned From Australia
claims.claim: The host says she was banned from Australia after what she calls the Zionist lobby of Australia sought it, because in politics you have to be pro-Israel or get destroyed.
claims.investigative_direction: Australian government visa decision records and the advocacy campaign that preceded it.
claims.transcript_snippet: Ban me from Australia after that Zionist lobby of Australia getting me banned like I'm some threat to society

claims.label: Host Says Ye Shared a Fan-Made Avengers Meme of His Chicago Return
claims.claim: The host says Ye shared a meme created by one of his fans framing his return to Chicago, with many artists brought on stage or in the audience, in Avengers style.
claims.investigative_direction: Find Ye's original post of the meme.
claims.transcript_snippet: Ye actually shared this meme which was created by one of his fans online

claims.label: Host Says She Would Still Sit Down With the Characters in Charlie's Life She Finds Suspicious
claims.claim: The host says she is no longer angry but would still sit down with all of the characters in Charlie's life who she thinks are moving suspiciously.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask which individuals she means and whether she has made specific invitations.
claims.transcript_snippet: I still would sit down with all of the characters in Charlie's life who I think are moving suspiciously.

claims.label: Host Says the Department of War Is Seeking Revenge on Her Side
claims.claim: The host says that she and others working for the truth know that the Department of War is seeking revenge on them for doing so, and that revenge will not beat the truth.
claims.investigative_direction: The host cites no specific action by the department; identify any official steps taken against her or her guests.
claims.transcript_snippet: the Department of War is seeking revenge on us for doing so.

claims.label: Host Says She Will Share Charlie and Candace Archive Material on September 10
claims.claim: The host says she is bringing up material from the archives of her time with Charlie and will share it on September 10.
claims.investigative_direction: Check what is published on September 10 against this stated plan.
claims.transcript_snippet: Too many great moments. Um a lot that I'm bringing up from the archives and I'll be sharing on September 10th.

claims.label: Host Says Charlie Was Present When She Met Ye and Appears in the Ye Documentary and TMZ Interview
claims.claim: The host says Charlie was with her when she met Ye, appears in the background of the TMZ interview in which Ye introduced her, and made it into the Ye documentary released last year.
claims.investigative_direction: Review the full TMZ interview and the documentary for Kirk's appearance and date.
claims.transcript_snippet: He was with me when I met Ye. He was by my side. He made it into the Ye documentary that was released last year.

claims.label: Ye in TMZ Clip Says Ebro Declined to Have Candace on Because She Is Mean
claims.claim: In the TMZ clip played by the host, Ye says he FaceTimed Ebro with Candace present, that Candace chopped Ebro's head off with facts, and that when he asked whether Ebro would have her on his show Ebro said no because she is mean.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the date of the TMZ interview and Ebro Darden's account, if any, of the exchange.
claims.transcript_snippet: I said, "Yo, you going to have Candace on your show?" He's like, "Nah, I'm not. She's mean."

claims.label: Host Says No Former Employer Created Her and Rejects Credit Claims
claims.claim: The host says some corporations and former executives she worked with claim to have helped create her, and she denies that any of them contributed to creating her.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the specific people who have made the claim; none is named on air.
claims.transcript_snippet: No, no, none of you created me. None of you contributed to creating me.

claims.label: Host Says Neff Got Into a Second Rental Denali With Danny Philip After Landing in Salt Lake City
claims.claim: The host says that although Neff flew into Salt Lake City with Charlie aboard Charlie's jets on September 10, he got into the second rental, a Denali, with Danny Philip and perhaps others, and then arrived at the event from the back seat as if someone else had been in the front.
claims.investigative_direction: Rental agreement, vehicle GPS or security footage showing who rode in the second vehicle.
claims.transcript_snippet: we know that Blake got into the second rental, a Denali, with Danny Philip and perhaps some other people

claims.label: Host Says Neither Danny Philip Nor Neff Attended the Restaurantology Event
claims.claim: The host says neither Danny Philip nor Blake Neff attended the Restaurantology event that morning where Charlie gave an interview.
claims.investigative_direction: Event attendee list, green-room footage and the restaurant's own video of the morning.
claims.transcript_snippet: We know that neither Danny or Blake attend the restaurantology event that morning where Charlie gave an interview.

claims.label: Host Says Neff Could Not Account for His Whereabouts and Had to Be Reminded Danny Was Driving
claims.claim: The host says Neff cannot account for where he was, says he was keeping time, did not remember who he was with, and had to be reminded that he was with Danny, who was driving the vehicle.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare Neff's own audio account with phone location records and Philip's statements.
claims.transcript_snippet: He didn't even remember who he was with. He had to be reminded that he was with Danny who was driving the vehicle.

claims.label: Host Says Neff Posted That She Cannot Imagine Someone Liking Work
claims.claim: The host says Neff tweeted over the last couple of days that she finds it implausible that Charlie would be excited about his largest campus tour because it was his job, calling her seven vacations a year Owens.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the original Neff post and its timestamp.
claims.transcript_snippet: Candace finds it implausible and ridiculous that Charlie would be excited about his largest campus tour ever because it was also his job.

claims.label: Host Says She Has Taken Three Vacations This Year: Spain, Russia and Iceland
claims.claim: The host says she has taken three vacations this year, a family holiday to Spain, a partial family trip to Russia without the youngest because of the flight, and a 7-year anniversary fishing trip to Iceland with her husband, which she offers as a correction to Neff's seven vacations.
claims.investigative_direction: Travel records for the host's 2026 trips would confirm or refute the count.
claims.transcript_snippet: Thus far this year, we've taken a total of three vacations, our family holiday to Spain, our partial family trip to Russia

claims.label: Host Says Charlie Rarely Took Time Off and Was Hardly Home
claims.claim: The host says Charlie rarely took time off, that she and her team tracked all of his dates and appearances, and that he was hardly home because he gave everything to build the organization.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare against Kirk's public 2025 schedule and tour dates.
claims.transcript_snippet: Charlie rarely took time off. We have obviously tracked all of his dates, all of his appearances. He was hardly home.

claims.label: Host Says TPUSA Has Not Been Honest About What Charlie Was Up Against in His Final Days
claims.claim: The host says the organization Charlie built now seeks to lie about who he was and has not been honest or forthcoming about what he was up against in his final days, what his struggles were and who he was fighting.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare TPUSA's public accounts of Kirk's final weeks with the text messages and timelines the host has aired.
claims.transcript_snippet: They've not been honest or forthcoming about what he was up against in his final days, what his struggles were, who he was fighting.

claims.label: Neff Quoted Saying Someone in the Waiting Room Predicted Candace's Extreme Reaction
claims.claim: In the passage the host reads from the Deseret News profile, Neff is quoted saying that someone said Candace was going to have an extreme reaction and that he instantly agreed she would.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the Deseret News article and identify who the unnamed speaker was.
